newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Few stocks moving in late trading.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Few stocks moving in late trading.

text.p: Another bad day on Wall Street on Wednesday apparently left traders eager to call it a day, as few stocks were active after the bell, traders said.

Even CompuServe Corp was inactive. It drew much interest during regular trading hours after it and its 80 percent owner H&R Block Inc said they were in discussions with a third party regarding a possible business combination involving CompuServe.
"After the close we have no trades," one trader said. "It's really very quiet."
CompuServe closed up 1-5/8 to 12-5/8. H&R Block was unchanged for the day at 30-5/8.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one volume was 74,400, compared with 613,100 on Tuesday. Session two volume was 5,152,784, while on Tuesday it was 8,094,962.
